notes: New Blender course: 45 lessons in seven units, from your first Python script in Blender to a finished game-asset pipeline, plus checkpoints, a final exam and a Blender 3D and pipeline certification
Your code runs in real Blender (5.2 LTS) in the background, so every scene you build, render and export is checked against what Blender actually produces

Units on modelling (bmesh, modifiers, UV unwrapping), materials and node shaders, lighting and rendering, keyframe animation, and procedural tools like Geometry Nodes, seeded generation and fast NumPy mesh edits
A game-asset pipeline unit: poly budgets and LODs, texture baking, exporting to game engines, batch jobs from the command line, asset libraries and automated quality checks
Four capstone projects that pull the whole course together
Blender joins the Games and Scripting categories; the app offers to install it if it's missing
